map.stage_allstar: All-Star Break — Mid Season - Difficulty: Hard

ratings_guide.title: 📊 RATINGS GUIDE
ratings_guide.con: CON — Contact: Determines the probability of making contact. High CON players have higher chances of singles and hits overall.
ratings_guide.pwr: PWR — Power: Probability of extra-base hits (doubles, triples, home runs). Also increases damage to opponent pitcher on deep hits.
ratings_guide.eye: EYE — Vision/Eye: Probability of getting walks (BB). Reduces strikeout zone. Crucial to avoid direct HP damage.
ratings_guide.spd: SPD — Speed: Triggers base stealing attempts on singles (+20% pitcher damage debuff). Also improves chance of converting hits to extra bases.
ratings_guide.def: DEF — Defense: Contributes to team Shield. Higher average DEF gives you more shield to absorb OUTs before losing HP.

mode_select.story_desc: Compete in any historical MLB season. Face real teams from that era and their top 3 pitchers all the way to the World Series Champion.
mode_select.quick_desc: The classic BaseRogue experience, face legendary opponents from different eras

season_select.title: 📜 SELECT THE SEASON
season_select.desc: Choose the year to compete against real teams from that era with their top 3 pitchers by WAR.

menu.intro_desc: Pick your players in {{rounds}} draft rounds to build your full 9-batter roster. Organize their defensive position (Drag & Drop) and batting order in real time. Then roll the dice each turn to determine the at-bat outcome. Defeat the rival rotation before your {{hp}} HP reaches zero.

draft.title: Player Signings (Draft)
draft.desc: Select a legend to join your roster. Choose wisely to optimize positions and activate Era or Franchise synergies.
draft.midrun_desc: Select a legend to sign with your budget, or decline the sign to continue the run.
draft.auto_sort_title: Sort logically: Speed 1st, Power 4th, Best batters 2nd & 3rd.
draft.decline_desc: Don't want to sign any legend or prefer saving your money? You can decline the sign and advance on the map.
draft.swap_modal_desc: Your bench and lineup are full. Select a current player to permanently replace them with the new sign:
draft.round_elite_hint: This is a guaranteed elite round. Take advantage of it to secure a quality starter.
draft.round_common_hint: Common round. These players will fill your remaining slots and form your bench.
draft.round_free_hint: Free round: any rarity from the pool may appear. Good luck!

pre_fight.title: Series Preparation
pre_fight.subtitle: You face the series against {{team}}. Make sure your batters are ready.

match.title: Batters to Battle
match.log_residual: ⚡ Residual damage! {{name}} comes in relieving -{{dmg}} HP impact ({{hp}}/{{maxHp}} HP).
match.log_defeat: 💀 DEFEAT. Your team reached 0 HP. Strikeouts wiped out your lineup.
match.log_victory: 🏆 VICTORY! You defeated the rival rotation.
match.win_desc: Extraordinary! You knocked out the full rotation of {{team}}.
match.loss_desc: The pitchers of {{team}} dominated the series. Your HP reached 0.

card_popup.swap_pos_desc: Swap defensive position of {{name}} with another starter. (Does NOT alter your batting order).

train_plans.sta_desc: Recovers +35 Stamina and adds +5 max Stamina.

events.ev_cork_desc: A mysterious merchant offers corked bats. It will boost team Power, but lower Contact.
events.ev_cork_choice1: Modify bats (+15 Power, -4 Contact for the whole team)
events.ev_fitness_desc: A trainer from the 1982 championship offers to coordinate an intense conditioning routine.
events.ev_fitness_choice1: Cardio routine (+40 Stamina for the whole roster)
events.ev_cryo_desc: You install an advanced recovery chamber in the locker room. Instantly heals the team, but costs money.
events.ev_pinetar_desc: You acquire a tub of special pine tar that improves bat grip, sharpening contact.
events.ev_pinetar_choice1: Buy pine tar (+8 global Contact for the whole team)
events.ev_bribe_desc: A scout offers budget money from the opposing team in exchange for sacrificing some focus.
events.ev_bribe_choice1: Accept money (Gain +$45 budget, but lose -5 global Vision/Eye)
events.ev_bribe_choice2: Report to commissioner (Gain +8 global Vision/Eye for your team)

train.title: Batting Cage / Bullpen
train.desc: Train a specific player's skills to permanently boost their base stats.

rest.heal_desc: Recover +40 energy/stamina for all active and bench players.
rest.sponsor_desc: Receive a direct +$25 cash bonus to spend in shops.

event.title: Manager's Office
